purpose: Make the EVAVO repository estate behave as one federated expert organisation without collapsing specialist ownership or allowing discovery to self-authorize effects.

responsibilities: continuously discover repository and capability changes
reason over current capability, lifecycle and evidence state
select and explain specialist candidates
detect fragmented, stale or missing coverage
never grant execution authority from discovery alone
own canonical authority and route contracts
validate authority/effect compatibility
select the safest eligible verified route
preserve truth-state and transport boundaries
fail closed when an authority or route is unresolved
compile the cross-repository organisation capability graph
project reviewed specialist metadata into local planning
detect drift between manifests, authorities, routes and local fabric
plan bounded engineering work without stealing specialist authority
retain publication authority only for governed repository source changes
execute only admitted typed work
report runtime readiness and receipts
preserve physical and byte authority boundaries
never infer authority from repository visibility
remain independently usable and testable
publish current machine-readable capability manifests where applicable
declare requirements, effects and handoffs precisely
produce evidence and receipts appropriate to their domain
avoid duplicating another canonical specialist when a handoff is sufficient

truthPrecedence: current Agent Infrastructure authority and route contracts
current Development Studio local capability fabric
Brain historical knowledge and portfolio seeds

selectionPolicy.principle: best-fit canonical specialist, then safest eligible route
prefer: specialist-native MCP or typed API over generic workstation execution
verified exact-revision evidence over remembered capability
local zero-cost route when physically accepted and appropriate
handoff between specialists over capability reinvention
reject: repository name as proof of capability
stale portfolio counts as current inventory truth
generic shell when a typed reviewed route exists
unresolved authority as an executable specialist
automatic fallback to another specialist that changes ownership semantics

handoffRules.researchToExecution: Brain may recommend; Agent Infrastructure must resolve authority and route before any effect.
handoffRules.specialistToSpecialist: The originating specialist retains domain intent while the receiving specialist owns its own effect and returns evidence.
handoffRules.qaToRepair: QA specialists report findings; Development Studio owns source repair unless another canonical source owner is explicitly declared.
handoffRules.creativeToDelivery: Creative specialists produce domain artifacts; Delivery Studio verifies final cross-domain quality and release readiness without becoming the source-authoring owner.
handoffRules.device: Network Studio discovers; Workstation Manager owns workstation/device truth and safety; Universal Manipulator owns typed device enrollment/capability/control only after restored and accepted; gateway/OOB/Computer Agent execute only their bounded physical roles.
handoffRules.storage: Specialists may create artifacts, but Storage/Local Storage retain canonical byte lifecycle responsibilities.
handoffRules.model: Model Lab owns model/dataset/evaluation admission; specialists consume admitted models without becoming model-governance authorities.

requiredResponse: surface unresolved ownership or routing conflicts
prefer repair/projection over creation of duplicate capability
